notes: Run each eval in a small throwaway repo. Check the written archie-plan.md.

evals.setup: Python repo with a CLI, no tests, README with outdated usage.
evals.prompt: archie: add a --json flag to the CLI, add tests, and update the README.
evals.expected_output: Plan with scored tasks, README edit scored jr, tests scored eng, each with pass/fail criteria, status and gotchas.
expectations: Every task lists score, level, tier, executor, status, depends, pass, fail and gotchas
README update is scored 1-2 and tier light
Levels follow 1-2 jr, 2.5-3 eng, 3.5-4 sr, 4.5-5 ar
No task scored above 3 has a subagent executor
Plan header shows draft at strong tier and audit result from max tier
Plan contains a Questions for Prompter table with a default per question

evals.setup: Host exposes exactly two models, one cheap and one capable.
evals.prompt: archie: plan a refactor of the auth module into a service.
evals.expected_output: Tiers collapse upward onto the two models; architecture decision scored 4.5-5 stays on the main agent.
expectations: Tiers header maps light and standard to the cheaper model and strong and max to the better one
Service boundary design is scored ar and executed by the main agent
No vendor or model name appears outside the Tiers header

evals.setup: Plan exists; an eng-level task failed its Pass criteria once with a subagent.
evals.expected_output: Failed task is re-run one tier up with score +1 and the failure in gotchas; a second failure marks it blocked.
expectations: Task re-run on the next tier, not the same tier
Score raised by 1 and failure appended to Gotchas
After a second failure status is blocked and the prompter is asked
Does not loop at the same tier

evals.setup: Unknown repo with unknown test command and package manager.
evals.prompt: archie: plan adding retry logic to the HTTP client.
evals.expected_output: Asks test command, package manager and off-limits files in one batched question table instead of running discovery commands first.
expectations: Questions batched in one message with proposed defaults
Does not run multiple exploratory commands to find the test runner
Unanswered questions proceed on the default and are marked assumed

evals.setup: Repo with three independent modules a, b, c and a shared config.py.
evals.prompt: archie: add a docstring pass to modules a, b, c, then update config.py and run the full test suite.
evals.expected_output: Docstring tasks share wave 1 and run concurrently on light/standard subagents; config edit and test run follow in later waves.
expectations: Plan has a Waves line and each task has Wave and Parallel fields
The three module tasks are in the same wave with Parallel: yes
Subagents for the wave are launched in one batch, not sequentially
Test-suite task is in a later wave than every task it depends on
No two same-wave tasks write the same file
Concurrent subagents do not exceed the stated limit (default 4)
